treasuryMigration.note: YieldTreasury above is the POST-MIGRATION address. The original is under migratedFrom; its remaining kfUSD was moved across, and on this chain its ledger and its balance agreed exactly, so nothing was left behind.
treasuryMigration.reason: userRewardDebt was never initialised when a holder acquired kafUSD, so every holder was entitled to yield that accrued before they arrived. claimYield subtracted it from the pool unguarded and underflowed, which reached users as PANIC 17 on the Claim button.
